title: Oase 1: Neanderthal ancestor a few generations back
summary: Remains of an early modern European, about 40,000 years old, carried about 6-9% Neanderthal DNA. His Neanderthal ancestor lived only about four to six generations before him.
why: Shows modern humans and Neanderthals also mixed in Europe, not only earlier.

notes.problem: Date arithmetic: c. 40,000 years ago gives year 1950-40000 = -38050, not -38500.
'Not only once in the Near East' is not in the source; source supports admixture in Europe only.
